body_text:
Riemann hypothesis. Every nontrivial zero $\rho$ of the Riemann
zeta function satisfies $\operatorname{Re}(\rho)=1/2$. The
hypothesis gives sharp control over the error in the average
distribution of prime numbers and is substantially stronger
than the prime number theorem itself.
